summary: Gorax showcases the Season 9 exclusive Radiant DPS and support hero Holfast, who officially replaces Lincos in Aura team compositions. Even at Inspiration 0, Holfast outperforms an Inspiration 5 Lincos in Temporal Vortex damage tests due to his energy feeding and massive team damage buffs. Holfast's exclusive talent extends his 30% team Damage Up buff to 20 seconds, allowing for near 100% uptime with proper gear like the Puppeteer set. His high-tier inspirations provide Radiance Vulnerability and bonus Radiant damage, making him a critical pickup on the guaranteed 1,000-dice banner. The video also highlights the synergy of upcoming tank Celestine and new Season 9 gear like the Crimson Dragonflame set.

meta_changes: Holfast replaces Lincos as the cornerstone support/DPS hybrid in Radiant Aura compositions.
Aura teams gain significantly higher Damage Up buff uptime (20s duration via Holfast's exclusive talent).
The new Season 9 Crimson Dragonflame gear set provides stacking damage boosts (up to 24%) against the lowest HP enemy.
tips: Save your dice for the S9 Aura banner to secure at least one guaranteed copy of Holfast at 1,000 dice.
Do not over-invest in Crit Rate on Talethia (aim around 80%) if pairing with Holfast, as his skill provides a 20% Crit Rate buff.
Equip Holfast with Puppeteer set to lower skill cooldowns to 18 seconds, ensuring 100% uptime on his 20-second 30% Damage Up talent buff.
Run Golden Antlers on Holfast, or alternatively Orb of the Dragon God or Angelic Alliance if Antlers is on another unit.
Utilize the new Crimson Dragonflame set across multiple heroes against single-target bosses for up to 3 stacks of 8% bonus damage.
